user.title: Citizen incident feed
user.description: Watch Citizen incidents within a radius of a point. Defaults to your Home Assistant location.

data_description.radius: Distance around the point to watch, 0.1-50 km
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll Citizen. Tiles are cached ~60s server-side; faster polling adds little.
data_description.include_historical: Also show older incidents from the historical tile layer (citizen_historical map source)
data_description.detail_count: Nearest N live incidents get full details: address, responding agency, latest update text. 0 disables.
